import { DataSource, Entity, EntityManager, Repository } from 'typeorm';

@Entity('note')
export class Note {}

@Entity('audit_log')
export class AuditRecord {}

class CustomBuilder {
  getMany(): unknown[] {
    return [];
  }
}

class CustomRepository {
  createQueryBuilder(_alias: string): CustomBuilder {
    return new CustomBuilder();
  }
}

export class QueryBuilderCases {
  constructor(
    private readonly notes: Repository<Note>,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
    private readonly manager: EntityManager,
    private readonly custom: CustomRepository,
    private readonly mixed: Repository<Note> | CustomRepository,
  ) {}

  // CASE:qb-repository-select
  readNote(id: string): Promise<Note | null> {
    return this.notes.createQueryBuilder('note').where('note.id = :id', { id }).getOne();
  }

  // CASE:qb-local-variable
  readMany(): Promise<Note[]> {
    const builder = this.notes.createQueryBuilder('note');
    builder.where('note.archived = false');
    return builder.getMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-explicit-join
  readWithAudit(): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.dataSource
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .select('note')
      .from(Note, 'note')
      .leftJoin(AuditRecord, 'audit', 'audit.noteId = note.id')
      .getRawMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-insert
  insert(title: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.dataSource
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .insert()
      .into(Note)
      .values({ title })
      .execute();
  }

  // CASE:qb-update
  update(id: string, title: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.manager
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .update(Note)
      .set({ title })
      .where('id = :id', { id })
      .execute();
  }

  // CASE:qb-delete
  delete(id: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.dataSource
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .delete()
      .from(Note)
      .where('id = :id', { id })
      .execute();
  }

  // CASE:qb-custom-lookalike
  customRead(): unknown[] {
    return this.custom.createQueryBuilder('note').getMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-ambiguous-receiver
  ambiguousRead(): unknown {
    return this.mixed.createQueryBuilder('note').getMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-relation-string-join
  relationJoin(): Promise<Note[]> {
    return this.notes
      .createQueryBuilder('note')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('note.comments', 'comment')
      .getMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-subquery-callback
  callbackSubquery(): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.dataSource
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .select('note')
      .from((subquery) => subquery.select('*').from(Note, 'note'), 'note')
      .getRawMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-cte
  cte(): Promise<Note[]> {
    return this.notes
      .createQueryBuilder('note')
      .addCommonTableExpression('SELECT "noteId" FROM "audit_log"', 'recent_audit')
      .getMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-conditional-reassignment
  reassigned(condition: boolean): Promise<Note[]> {
    let builder = this.notes.createQueryBuilder('note');
    if (condition) builder = this.notes.createQueryBuilder('other_note');
    return builder.getMany();
  }

  // CASE:qb-get-sql-not-terminal
  inspectOnly(): string {
    return this.notes.createQueryBuilder('note').getSql();
  }
}
